message.content: I check the tickets at the entrance, make sure the snack shelves are filled, and sweep the lobby. I usually start at eight in the morning and take the tram to get there. It's a routine, and I find that when I stick to it, the voice isn't as loud. Most days are pretty quiet, but sometimes when I'm tired or haven't slept well, I hear it more. I don't know what it's saying, just that it's there. My sister thinks I should see someone about it, so that's why I'm here.
